name: Mobile Transport & Inter-Component Security
description: Assessment of mobile application network transport security and inter-component communication. Covers TLS configuration analysis, certificate validation, inter-app communication (intents, URL schemes, deep links), and backend API interaction security from the mobile client perspective.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to mobile transport or IPC security testing

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands mobile network security and IPC concepts
evidence: Can explain certificate pinning, ATS, and Network Security Config
Understands Android Intents and iOS URL schemes as IPC mechanisms
Familiar with common mobile transport security weaknesses

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Intercepts and analyzes mobile traffic under supervision
evidence: Configured proxy interception for mobile devices (Burp/mitmproxy)
Identified cleartext traffic or weak TLS configurations
Tested basic IPC mechanisms under supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses transport and IPC security on mobile engagements
evidence: Independently tested transport security on 5+ mobile engagements
Evaluates certificate pinning implementations and identifies bypasses
Tests intent filters, deep links, and custom URL schemes for injection
Passed proficiency assessment on mobile transport and IPC security

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex transport analysis; tests custom protocols
evidence: Analyzes custom binary protocols used by mobile applications
Tests WebSocket and non-HTTP transport channels
Evaluates mutual TLS and custom certificate validation logic
Mentors junior testers on mobile network interception setup

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Authority on mobile transport security; develops methodology
evidence: Published research on mobile transport or IPC vulnerabilities
Developed lab methodology for mobile network security testing
Discovers vulnerabilities in platform-level IPC implementations
Trains teams on advanced mobile transport analysis

assessment_methods.description: Intercept, analyze, and identify vulnerabilities in a mobile app's network traffic and IPC mechanisms
Observe proxy setup, certificate installation, and traffic interception workflow
